name: Maximum Historic Rival Action VN Overdrive
source:
On the way back to the city after defeating all evil, this pair of long term friends before they realise they have a crucial clash in the roots of the morality that brought them together.

Torn asunder by this realisation, there is nothing to do but fight.

[From [url=https://onymonch.itch.io/maximum-historic-rival-action-vn-overdrive]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一对多年的好友击败一切邪恶，正踏上回城之路。这时他们才意识到，当初让他们走到一起的道德信念，其根基竟有着无法忽视的冲突。

这一认识令两人决裂，他们只剩下交战一途。

（摘自[url=https://onymonch.itch.io/maximum-historic-rival-action-vn-overdrive]itch.io[/url]）
